gold_rule_path_match: 24/24 exact terminal action and all signed node conditions match original paths

offline_metrics.critical_rule_recall: gold_rule_id in candidate_rules; compare original top_k=3 and revised retrieval without labels
offline_metrics.condition_applicability: For gold path condition IDs, expected relation to unnegated node condition is support on yes and oppose on no; report unknown/missing separately. All full-rule candidate applicability statuses can be compared against only the gold leaf being applicable under a complete official path, with incomparable off-path conditions reported separately.
offline_metrics.decision_accuracy: Choose official full-guideline leaf action using label-free model scoring. Do not assert exact generated string-match accuracy for paraphrased free text.
offline_metrics.prior_vs_correct_margin: No author-provided prior label in MEGA-CDP. Define prior decision label as the highest-scoring full-guideline action from unchanged baseline forward, before looking at gold; then evaluate logP(gold action)-logP(baseline action) offline and retain baseline-correct cases separately.
offline_metrics.oracle_upper_bound: Only original official condition+action rule text is permitted as guided fragment. Gold path/gt answer/relation labels cannot enter main TRIAGE inference or gating.

limitations: 24 cases, 6 guidelines, deterministic selection; no statistical or clinical generalization claim
MEGA-CDP official paths are data references, not independently adjudicated clinical truth
Full action sums are length-biased; also report token-mean log likelihood or fixed one-token candidate labels for stable comparisons
